sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 380. Success value 100. 5x magic damage (Water).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Applies Kismet.
-Target: all allies. Status ailment resistance value boosted by 60 for 90 seconds.
-Applies Field Protect to the allied Field.
-Target: all allies. Applies Rage for 90 seconds (increases max HP, ATK, and MATK by 100%; nullifies status ailments and Cost reduction. When in effect, recovers 30% of your character's max HP, recovers 30 Cost, and removes debuffs/special debuffs when you defeat an enemy).
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies World Element (increases max HP by 100%, increases all stats by 100%, increases critical hit chance by 100%, and nullifies buff removal effects and debuffs) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Permits piercing through damage reduction/reflection effects when attacking for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
Water and Time Defense from Unison Damage +500

[Eternal Chains: Slave] Kyouka Uzen or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
